review: Original Q24 Trainer read-only B adapter

findings.conclusion: The public readback handle has private original Prepared, Training and cancellation Arcs and exact Dataset/Training cuts. Its product constructor is private to the original aggregate lane; installation compares all three Arc identities and the exact Dataset. No public raw receipt provider, mutable trainer, key, fit or attestation API is introduced.

Evaluation holds the original aggregate lane, then readback enters only the distinct Training try-acquire semaphore/mutex. The readback does not call aggregate admission again. install paths release the first Training read before reading the cap. Model dispatch calls evaluation.complete before and after with_original_trainer, not while retaining its Training permit. No new lock wait cycle was identified; contention remains a refusal rather than a waiting acquire.

Export and installation remain inside aggregate in_lane with original Root/source pre/post checks and original cancellation drop-fence. The cap checks its shared cancellation flag before/after source and cut checks, and checks context before/after its actual original Training read. Training additionally checks its private original Dataset provenance before/after completion read. Missing, Pending and current source invalidity are not converted to NoUpdate. The cap is only Training evidence access, not a standalone Root publication credential.

Original receipt owner prepare, authenticate_roles, validate_config, attest, completed-authentication and readback bodies are unchanged after the exact closed-source enum/type/method renames listed above. Actual runner/holdout/execution-key readback, current Generator/Evaluator signatures, exact original trainer principal and signed actor separation remain. Original external EvidenceClient API is retained as a wrapper with its original pinned-client path.

The already integrated read_original_training_material returns exact native candidate completion, scope and Training cut from actual owner reads. The new original_training_readback returns the retained native attestation from that same owner. A host can pass the opaque cap to OriginalQ24 inputs and install completed B without copying/signing intermediate Training evidence or running a second evidence server against the aggregate. Actual independent B plans, holdout, execution owners and signing capabilities still have to be supplied and executed.

The semantic delta adds 12 exact boundaries and four protected file blocks, adjusts actual external-readback callers, and retains public legacy wrappers with empty product caller sets. Guard order for receipt-owner signing, execution-key restriction and original independent role checks is preserved under the new method names. Official typed scan of the final formatted integrated source was not run by this reviewer.

Three added component methods exercise actual original Dataset/native Training readback, copied receipt/source/fence rejection, missing completion without fit, source withdrawal, cancellation flag and corrected Dataset invalidity, with original durable bytes preserved. They use fixture custody and do not execute independent B or Root enrollment. The cancellation test sets the shared flag; it is not a new in-flight future-drop or whole-chain recovery execution.

real_root_fixture_handoff.limitations: Existing broker fixture is synthetic EvaluationNoUpdate and lacks actual A/B/Model-factory production preparation. Its real Root/pidfd/five-lane/claim-dispatch/CURRENT mechanics may be reused; synthetic scope/material/checkpoint history must be replaced by the new actual Prepared and owner outputs. Pins were sent to the component-chain author.
